author: 343paulinef

title: Food Tour is Great!
text: The food on this tour is incredible! Great bites to eat and drinks at four different stops. Along with the history of the city, you get to know the streets and landmarks along the way. I only wish they would add ~15-10 min. onto the tour as a whole to have time for shopping in the market, as by the time the tour is over, the market is closed.
author: Christopher_H

title: Eat where the chefs do!
text: This was a truly amazing food tour! Our guide was so knowledgeable and brought us on 3 stops to stop/sit and eat, plus La Boqueria Market! We went to eat, tapas, wine, meat, cheese, and more. One of my favorite stops was to stand only shop, that only serves three things, including crispy fresh fried sardines. This was the place that Anthony Bourdain used to go to. Truly was wonderful gastronomic and historical experience!
author: Carrie_R

title: Perfect introduction to Barcelona
text: Adrian was our guide and he provided an excellent (as well as entertaining) overview of the history and food culture of Barcelona. I have recommended him to several fellow travelers. This tour is a perfect introduction to Barcelona for a first time visitor!
author: Laura_S

title: Fantastic Tour, Filled with History and Food
text:
As other reviewers have said, this is a wonderful introduction to both history and food in Barcelona. I would highly recommend this on your first day touring the city. Adrian did an amazing job of explaining both history and food, and we had plenty of tasty snacks and drinks along the way. As a solo traveler, this was a great tour and we went to places I would have never found on my own.

author: Mary_R

title: Recommended the same evening!
text: Interesting. The history of the Romans was recited. We also received great suggestions for further self-guided excursions. Danke an Adrian.
author: manfredschreiber2016

title: Great tour with food, history, culture
text: Great tour! Our guide was knowledgeable and interesting, the food variety was good and tasted really good. It was just the right length and right mix of history, local culture, and good food.
author: Marie_H

title: Taste of Barcelona Food Tour
text:
Great tastings of various tapas, sweets and drinks. Our guide, Adrian, was also very knowledgeable about the different sections of old town Barcelona. 
Part of our group was delayed and instead of cancelling us or making us switch to another time or date, Adrian gave my husband and I a private tour. He was worth his weight in gold!
Highly recommend this tour!
author: Gayle_L

title: Definitely recommend
text: Adrien was very knowledgeable and entertaining throughout the whole tour. More tasting options than we expected, we were definitely full by the end of the tour. Not small portions. Whole family had a great experience
author: susan_w

title: Delicious First Day in Barcelona
text: Our family of 4 (including 2 teenagers) took this tour our first day in Barcelona and it was a great introduction to the city and food we’d be enjoying the rest of our stay. Adrian was an entertaining and informative tour guide. Come with an empty stomach because you will be enjoying several stops with delicious food. Adrian also provided us with recommendations for activities and restaurants we enjoyed the rest of our time in Barcelona. Highly recommend!
author: Amy_P
